title: 初詣のいろいろな場面
subject_en: Hatsumode (first shrine visit of the year) situations with ONE or two ordinary adults in winter coats, dot eyes, each a small complete scene with a few props, loose hand-drawn style. No real shrine names. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: 鳥居をくぐる、おみくじを結ぶ、お賽銭、甘酒、破魔矢。初詣のひとコマ12場面。お正月のブログ、おたより、SNSに。
